content: SalonDesk is a multi-salon booking platform. Clients discover beauty services, organizations manage staff and schedules, and platform admins approve salons and commissions.

To book: choose a salon and service, pick an available time, sign in if needed, accept hold terms, then a PayPal authorization hold reserves the amount until the appointment completes or a no-show fee applies.

Default cancellation policy allows free cancel at least 24 hours before start. Late cancel may charge about 25 percent. No-show fee is typically 50 percent of the service price. Exact fees follow the salon active policy.
SalonDesk uses PayPal authorization holds. Funds are reserved at booking, captured on completion or no-show fee, and voided on free cancellation within the policy window.
Roles include client, org owner, reception, stylist, platform admin, and platform staff. Clients book services. Org roles manage that salon only. Platform roles oversee all organizations.
Each service defines simultaneous capacity — how many clients can receive that service at the same time. Availability also respects organization working hours and existing bookings.
Organizations must submit change requests for PayPal account updates and cancellation policy changes. Platform admins approve or reject before changes take effect.
The SalonDesk voice assistant helps find services and book appointments. It uses retrieved platform data and does not invent prices or open appointment slots without data.
If a question is outside verified knowledge, the assistant should say so briefly and suggest using the SalonDesk app catalog or contacting the salon reception.
